title: Workforce Development Embedded Advisor
description: THE OPPORTUNITY We are seeking a Workforce Development Embedded Advisor who will serve as a senior strategic liaison embedded within Rwandas Ministry of Education, acting as a bridge between the Foundation and key government stakeholders. The role is responsible for advancing workforce development and education initiatives by closely with government officials, development and implementing partners, and stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery, build capacity, and foster collaborative relationships. Working at both strategic and operational levels, the Advisor brings a systems-thinking approach to complex education and workforce development challenges, helping align Foundation programming with Rwandas vision of becoming a knowledge-based, innovation-driven economy powered by human capital development. The role influences key stakeholders, strengthens partnerships across the education ecosystem, and supports the design and implementation of solutions that drive sustainable, system-level impact. WAYS YOU CAN CONTRIBUTE Taskforce Team Operationalization: Establish Taskforce teams comprising stakeholders from government agencies, development partners, and industry partners to enable the implementation and operationalization of each project activity. Managing New Programs’ Inception Activities to ensure alignment of development partners on post-Day Zero deliverables, ensuring seamless transition and implementation of project activities. Arrange stakeholder consultations to inform outcome delivery, ensuring that project activities are tailored to meet the needs of key stakeholders. Carry out needs assessments in the Ministry to stand up capacity for proper implementation, identifying areas for capacity building and technical assistance Develop a capacity development plan to address identified needs, ensuring that the Ministry has the necessary skills and expertise to implement project activities Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with government officials, development partners, and stakeholders to facilitate collaboration, communication, and problem-solving. The role will also facilitate clear communication channels between project teams and stakeholders, gather feedback, manage expectations, and resolve conflicts as needed Capacity Building: Identify capacity-building needs and provide technical assistance to government officials and project staff to enhance their project management and implementation skills. Monitoring and Evaluation: Support the monitoring and evaluation of project activities, identifying areas for improvement and implementing corrective actions as needed. Knowledge & Documentation: Maintain a centralized repository of project plans, templates, lessons learned, and best practices, while also providing training resources to enhance team competencies. Transparency & Reporting: Ensure that essential, accurate information is always available to support decision-making. This includes project archiving, documentation management, and historical project data for future references. Project Oversight & Multi-Project Management: Monitor project progress, identify deviations, manage cross-project dependencies, and prepare executive portfolio updates/reports for management decisions. WHO YOU ARE An advanced degree (Master’s or above) in Project Management, Business Administration, Workforce Development, or a related field. A minimum of 7 years’ experience in project management, coordination or implementation, preferably in a development context. Demonstrated experience having worked in government or international development especially in the education sector in Rwanda. Demonstrated Systems-Level Leadership, applied a systems-thinking approach to understand the broader education and workforce development ecosystem. Able to identify opportunities to address complex challenges through systemic solutions rather than isolated interventions. Able to connect national policy objectives with implementation realities at local and community Demonstrated experience in assessing how various actors, programs, and investments interact within the broader ecosystem. Strong project management, coordination skills Excellent communication, interpersonal and stakeholder engagement skills Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with multiple stakeholders Proficiency in project management tools and software (e.g. Asana, Trello, MS Project) Experience with capacity building, technical assistance and stakeholder engagement Fluency in English (written and spoken) and Kinyarwanda The Mastercard Foundation values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the organization and we are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Completion of satisfactory business references and background checks are essential conditions of employment. For more information and to sign up for the Foundation’s newsletter, please visit http://www.mastercardfdn.org/ Follow the Foundation on Twitter at MastercardFdn

title: Consultant, Head, Strategic Delivery SET
description: THE OPPORTUNITY This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, and program delivery, helping shape and embed a modern, agile way of working across SET. As a key member of cross-functional delivery teams, the Consultant, Head, Strategic Delivery Secondary Education & Transition (SET) will lead complex initiatives from concept to execution, bringing structure to ambiguity, accelerating results, and driving impact across the organization. Reporting to the Director, Strategic Delivery, the Head, Strategic Delivery Secondary Education & Transition (SET) will be working closely with senior leaders and enterprise stakeholders, and play a pivotal role in building the systems, processes, and culture required to deliver SETs ambitious mandate. Contract duration : 1 Year. If you are excited by the challenge of driving transformational work, influencing across diverse stakeholders, and building the systems and culture that enable exceptional delivery, this role offers an opportunity to make a significant and lasting impact. WAYS YOU CAN CONTRIBUTE In this role, you will serve as a strategic delivery leader, ensuring high-priority initiatives move from ideas to measurable outcomes through strong project leadership, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement. Key areas of impact include: Lead complex, cross-functional projects and workstreams, driving delivery against milestones, timelines, and strategic objectives. Partner with senior leaders and diverse stakeholder groups to solve complex challenges and remove barriers to execution. Build and embed agile delivery practices, operational systems, tools, and processes that enhance efficiency and scalability. Foster a culture of continuous improvement by identifying, codifying, and implementing best practices. Drive collaboration across functions including Finance, Legal, Compliance, People & Culture, Technology, and other enterprise teams. Support the adoption of innovative ways of working while influencing culture and mindset shifts across teams. Success in the role will be measured by: Consistent on-time and high-quality delivery of projects and workstreams. Adoption of new ways of working and delivery frameworks across teams. Strong stakeholder satisfaction and cross-functional collaboration. Meaningful process improvements and operational efficiencies. Positive influence on team capability, accountability, and execution excellence WHO YOU ARE You are a highly strategic and execution-oriented professional who thrives in complex, fast-moving environments. You excel at bringing clarity to ambiguity, influencing without authority, and driving results through collaboration. Mindset Agile, adaptable, and comfortable navigating uncertainty. A proactive problem-solver who combines strategic thinking with practical execution. Highly collaborative with strong influencing and relationship-building skills. Resilient, self-directed, and energized by creating order in evolving environments. Passionate about driving impact and enabling organisational success. Academic Qualifications Bachelors degree in Business, Management, or a related field. Masters degree or equivalent advanced professional experience is advantageous. Project Management certification (e.g., PMP) is beneficial. Technical Experience 12 years of professional experience, including leadership or supervisory responsibilities. Strong background in project delivery, strategic planning, operational excellence, or consulting. Management consulting experience is highly valued. Proven experience leading complex initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and dependencies. Exposure to education, development, or social impact sectors is advantageous. Core Competencies Strategic problem-solving and structured thinking. Advanced project and programme management capabilities. Stakeholder management and executive-level facilitation. Work planning, prioritisation, and execution management. Influencing and driving accountability across matrixed teams. Strong written communication, presentation, and facilitation skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management tools. Location Flexibility We are open to exceptional candidates based in any of our countries of operations in Africa or in Canada, reflecting our commitment to attracting the best talent to advance impact across the continent. The Mastercard Foundation values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the organization and we are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Completion of satisfactory business references and background checks are essential conditions of employment. title: Consultant, Senior Technical Advisor, Secondary Education & Transitions  (SET)
description: THE OPPORTUNITY This is an exciting opportunity for a senior education leader to help shape the future of education and youth transitions across Africa. Reporting to the Senior Director, Secondary Education and Transitions (SET), the Senior Technical Advisor, SET is a trusted advisor to the SET platform and Mastercard Foundation leadership. You will influence strategy, inform high-impact programming, and engage with governments, development partners, and key education stakeholders to drive transformative changes in education systems. This role is ideal for a thought leader who is passionate about challenging conventional approaches, advancing innovation, and helping scale impactful education solutions that improve opportunities for young people. Contract duration : 1 Year. This role offers a rare opportunity to influence education transformation at scale, working alongside visionary leaders and partners to help create more inclusive pathways for young people to learn, thrive, and access dignified work across Africa. WAYS YOU CAN CONTRIBUTE As a strategic advisor and trusted thought partner, you will provide technical expertise, ecosystem insights, and stakeholder engagement support to strengthen the Foundations education portfolio and long-term impact. Key areas of contribution include: Advise on the development of education strategies, transformative initiatives, and program design across the SET portfolio. Provide expert insight on education systems, policy trends, and emerging opportunities across Africa. Support the design of sustainable, system-level interventions that improve learning outcomes and youth transitions to work. Cultivate and strengthen relationships with governments, ministries, education institutions, development partners, and other ecosystem actors. Contribute to thought leadership, evidence generation, policy engagement, and ecosystem convenings. Serve as a strategic sounding board to senior leaders while remaining hands-on in supporting program delivery and implementation. Success in the role will be measured by: Timely delivery of high-quality advisory outputs and strategic recommendations. Positive stakeholder and government engagement outcomes. Effective contribution to program design, implementation, and impact. Strong alignment with Foundation values and strategic objectives. Ability to influence thinking, challenge assumptions, and advance innovative solutions across the education ecosystem. WHO YOU ARE You are a respected education expert with deep knowledge of African education systems and a passion for transforming learning and transition pathways for young people. You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach and are comfortable challenging ideas, influencing senior stakeholders, and navigating complex environments. Mindset Visionary, innovative, and intellectually curious. Passionate about transforming education systems at scale. Comfortable challenging the status quo and driving new thinking. Collaborative and influential, with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders. Equally capable of providing strategic guidance and rolling up your sleeves to deliver results. Academic Qualifications Advanced academic background in Education, Public Policy, International Development, Social Sciences, or a related field. Additional postgraduate qualifications are advantageous. Technical Experience 15 years of experience in education, development, public sector, or related fields. Strong understanding of African education systems, policy landscapes, and reform priorities. Experience engaging with Ministries of Education, government agencies, development partners, NGOs, and other ecosystem stakeholders. Demonstrated expertise in strategy development, program design, implementation, and systems change. Knowledge of emerging trends in education, including technology-enabled learning, digital transformation, and workforce readiness. Core Competencies Strategic advisory and thought leadership. Education policy and systems strengthening. Stakeholder engagement and relationship management. Program development and impact-driven implementation. Communication, negotiation, and influencing skills. Strong judgment, diplomacy, and political acumen. Ability to work effectively across complex, multi-stakeholder environments. Location Flexibility We are open to exceptional candidates based in any of our countries of operations in Africa, reflecting our commitment to attracting the best talent to advance impact across the continent. The Mastercard Foundation values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the organization and we are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Completion of satisfactory business references and background checks are essential conditions of employment. title: Consultant, Senior Transitions
description: THE OPPORTUNITY Join the Mastercard Foundation’s Secondary Education and Transitions (SET) platform and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of education and youth employment across Africa. This is a unique opportunity for a seasoned education and development leader to provide high-level strategic and technical advice that influences large-scale education initiatives, strengthens education systems, and improves pathways for young people to transition from learning into dignified and fulfilling work. Reporting to the Director, Transitions, the Consultant, Senior Transitions will be working closely with governments, ministries, development partners, education institutions, and Foundation teams, to help drive innovative, scalable, and sustainable solutions that advance educational access, quality, inclusion, and employment outcomes for Africa’s youth. Contract duration : 1 Year. If you are a Senior Transitions professional looking to increase your impact with bold ambitions to do to do large-scale programs to address the challenge of youth unemployment and want this to be part of your legacy , read on! WAYS YOU CAN CONTRIBUTE As a trusted advisor and ecosystem connector, you will: Provide strategic and technical guidance to inform education strategies, program design, and implementation across the SET portfolio. Shape innovative initiatives that strengthen secondary education systems and improve transitions into employment and entrepreneurship. Advise on partnerships, stakeholder engagement, and government relations to support impact at scale. Contribute to monitoring, evaluation, governance, and learning frameworks that strengthen program effectiveness and sustainability. Support thought leadership, research, evidence generation, and policy engagement that influence the education ecosystem. Success in this role will be measured through: Delivery of high-quality strategic advice and programmatic recommendations. Timely completion of agreed deliverables and stakeholder engagement activities. Strong relationships with government and ecosystem partners. Contributions that advance systems-level impact, sustainability, and improved outcomes for young people. WHO YOU ARE You are a mission-driven education and development expert with a passion for transforming opportunities for young people across Africa. You thrive in complex environments, bring credible influence with senior stakeholders, and combine strategic thinking with practical execution. Qualifications & Experience Minimum 15 years of experience in education, international development, or related sectors. Deep understanding of education systems, policy reform, and youth transitions to work. Demonstrated experience working with Ministries of Education, governments, development partners, NGOs, and other key stakeholders. Strong track record in strategy development, program design, proposal development, and project leadership. Key Competencies Strategic and systems thinking. Exceptional stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills. Strong communication, facilitation, and influencing capability. Sound judgment, diplomacy, and political acumen. Ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder environments and drive alignment toward shared impact Location Flexibility We are open to exceptional candidates based anywhere in Africa, reflecting our commitment to attracting the best talent to advance impact across the continent.
